subject: School Committee Goal Setting
overview: The School Committee met in a Committee of the Whole session to discuss setting committee goals for the term. The committee approved motions to limit the target to three goals and set a timeline concluding on November 30.

items.title: School Committee Goals and Evaluation Process
items.summary: The committee voted to set three goals running through November 30, 2023, with a December evaluation period, and agreed to finalize the specific goals at a future meeting.
